tools.name: get_school_status
tools.description: California Licensing Education’s current enrollment and completion-reporting availability as its service reports it, its DMV license details and public contact information. Availability is not a payment processor’s status or a court’s receipt of a completion.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: The school’s published program pages with live availability. Each program has a guidanceId that get_guidance accepts.

tools.name: search_guidance
tools.description: Search the school’s reviewed public guidance on California traffic school: licensing, school and court costs, court fees by county, eligibility and the 18-month rule, deadlines and extensions, points and insurance, completion reporting, commercial licenses, and county court steps. Returns navigation

tools.name: get_guidance
tools.description: One reviewed guidance answer by ID (from search_guidance, availableGuidanceIds or list_programs), with its source URLs, review date and the school’s live availability. An answer may be a short summary; open its linked school page for the complete page. Answers summarize cited pages as of their revie

tools.name: find_court_information
tools.description: Official superior court website and California Courts directory record for one county (the county on the citation), or all 58 when county is omitted. website is the court’s destination and sourceUrl its directory evidence. For counties with a published school guide, nextSteps links that guide’s perm

tools.name: get_eligibility_checklist
tools.description: Steps for confirming traffic-school permission with the court: the deadline, separate court fees, choosing a licensed school, and confirming the court received the completion. It lists what to check with the court; it is not an eligibility decision.

tools.name: calculate_insurance_comparison
tools.description: Compares two premiums the user supplies for the same coverage over a chosen number of months, then adds the user’s school, court and optional costs. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guidance, get_guidance · Private data: get_school_status, find_court_information · Public sink: find_court_information.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guidance, get_guidance · Private data: get_school_status, find_court_information · Public sink: find_court_information

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
